title: Chain rule
text: If the upper limit is u(x), then the derivative is $$f{\left(u\left(x\right)\right)} \operatorname{u'}\left(x\right)$$. If the lower limit is v(x), subtract $$f{\left(v\left(x\right)\right)} \operatorname{v'}\left(x\right)$$.

title: Use the upper limit $$u(x)=x^2$$
text: The derivative is $$\frac{\sqrt{x^2}}{1+x^2}$$ times $$2x$$. Since $$\sqrt{x^2}=|x|$$, this is $$\frac{2x |x|}{1+x^2}$$.
